name: The Tower
effectText: Turn all Adept cards face down. Players will have to pay 1 salt to refresh.

name: Death
effectText: All Hands are returned to the deck. The Agekeeper shuffles the deck.

name: The Sun
effectText: All players receive one of each Reagent.

name: Judgement
effectText: Draw 1 card for each Cauldron you have lit.

name: Justice
effectText: All Duels and Gambits are resolved via a best-of-3 series until the end of the round.

name: The Moon
effectText: Draw four cards from the top of the Deck. Keep any two. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

name: The Fool
effectText: Draw 2 cards. Your Opponents receive 1 Reagent of their choice.

name: Wheel of Fortune
effectText: All players roll their Zodiac Dice. Highest roll gains 2 Salt. Lowest roll discards 1 card.

name: The Hanged Man
effectText: All players pass their Hand cards to the Player to their Left.

name: The Lovers
effectText: Pick 1 other player. They choose both for you, either: Draw 2 cards or Gain 1 Reagent of their choice.

name: The Magician
effectText: Ignore Card Lock. Swap cards freely between Hand and Spread.

name: The High Priestess
effectText: Draw your Harvest directly from the Deck and +2 cards. Return any two after reviewing all.
effectTextResonant: Expand your maximum Hand limit to 7 cards.

name: The Empress
effectText: Craft One Reagent type 2-for-1. Mark the matching Cauldron with Salt.
effectTextResonant: Apply 2-for-1 to any two Reagent types.

name: The Emperor
effectText: Protect any 2 Spread cards from being lost in Duels or Gambits.
effectTextResonant: Protect any 2 cards from any type of attack.

name: The Hierophant
effectText: Shift your Zodiac Dice roll ±1 Sign on the Zodiac Wheel for Harvest or Opposition.
effectTextResonant: Shift your Zodiac Dice roll ±2. Apply this effect during any Opposition.

name: The Devil
effectText: Sacrifice any card to steal any one card from an opponent's Spread.
effectTextResonant: Sacrifice this card to Banish an opponent's Adept card. Both cards are returned to the deck.

name: The Chariot
effectText: Initiate Duels without an Ante card.
effectTextResonant: Gain a reroll in any duel.

name: Strength
effectText: +1 to Duel dice rolls.

name: The Hermit
effectText: Hold up to 3 Adept cards.
effectTextResonant: All elemental Aspect alignments are doubled. (Fire, Air, Water, Earth)

name: Temperance
effectText: Craft Salt for any Two Cards.
effectTextResonant: Salt is a Wild Reagent for one other type. Mark the matching Cauldron with Salt.

name: The Star
effectText: Anytime you lose a Duel, Gambit or Opposition, draw two cards.
effectTextResonant: Nullify an Adept or Fate card effect in play. Pay 1 Salt to refresh.

name: The World
effectText: Your Ward Reagents remain with you after successful Transmutations.
effectTextResonant: This card is a Wildcard for any Crucible card. Flip to activate. Refresh for 1 Salt.
